sections.description:
Opening Statement

Convert your WordPress site into a native iOS and Android app in under 24 hours — no coding required.

WebToNative is the fastest, most affordable way to get your WordPress or WooCommerce website on the App Store and Google Play. Your app stays permanently synced with your website — any change you make goes live instantly in the app, with no separate codebase to manage.

Trusted by 400,000+ businesses worldwide. Transparent pricing. No hidden limits. No surprise charges.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the WebToNative WordPress plugin
  2. Enter your website URL on webtonative.com
  3. Customise your app — branding, navigation, features
  4. We build and submit your app to Google Play and the App Store
  5. Your app goes live in under 24 hours

Why WebToNative?

✅ Both Android & iOS — included in every plan
No upsells. No platform-specific pricing. Build for both app stores from one dashboard.

✅ 400,000+ apps already built
The most proven website-to-app platform on the market. Trusted by businesses in 150+ countries.

✅ Transparent pricing — no hidden limits
What you see is what you pay. No undisclosed build limits, no surprise charges, no auto-upgrades without your consent.

✅ Real-time sync with your WordPress site
Update a product, post, or page — it reflects instantly in the app. One platform to manage, zero extra work.

✅ App delivered in under 24 hours
From sign-up to a published, fully functional app in less than a day. Faster than any competitor.

✅ 24/7 support
Our team is available around the clock. Real humans. Fast responses. Reach us at support@webtonative.com.

Key Features

  • 📲 Native Android & iOS Apps — Real native apps published to Google Play and the App Store under your own developer account.
  • 🔄 Real-Time Website–App Sync — Your app automatically reflects every change made to your WordPress site.
  • 🔔 Push Notifications — Send unlimited push notifications. Announce sales, new posts, and promotions.
  • 🛒 Deep WooCommerce Integration — Products, cart, checkout, and all major payment gateways work out of the box.
  • 🔐 Social Login — Google, Facebook, and Apple sign-in built in. Reduce login friction and increase registrations.
  • 💰 AdMob Monetisation — Integrate Google AdMob to earn ad revenue. Banner, interstitial, and rewarded formats are supported.
  • 📴 Offline Screen — Custom-branded no-internet screen keeps your brand present when users are offline.
  • 📊 In-App Purchases (IAP) — Sell premium content, features, or subscriptions on Android and iOS.
  • 🎨 Full Branding Control — Custom app icon, splash screen, bottom navigation, floating button, and colour scheme.
  • 📷 Barcode & QR Scanner — AI-powered scanning for inventory management, product lookups, and in-store experiences.
  • 🔗 Deep Linking — Link directly to specific pages, products, or content inside your app from external sources.
  • ⚡ JavaScript Bridge — Connect native device features to your web content without writing any native code.

Plugin Features

The WebToNative WordPress plugin enables the following directly from your WordPress dashboard:

  • Social Login — Enable Google, Facebook, and Apple sign-in. Configure credentials once, works instantly.
  • Push Notifications — Integrate with OneSignal (free) and Firebase (paid) to send real-time alerts and updates directly to app users.
  • In-App Purchases — Enable IAP on Android and iOS from the plugin settings panel.
  • Shortcode Support — Use [webtonative_social_login] to add social login to any custom theme or page builder.

Links & Resources

  • WebToNative Website: https://www.webtonative.com/
  • Pricing Plans: https://www.webtonative.com/pricing
  • Documentation: https://www.webtonative.com/docs
  • Support: https://www.webtonative.com/support
  • Email: support@webtonative.com
sections.installation:
From your WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for WebToNative
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Go to WebToNative in your left sidebar
  5. Sign up or log in at webtonative.com to connect your site

From WordPress.org

  1. Download the WebToNative plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin from your Plugins page
  5. Go to WebToNative in your sidebar to get started
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills to build my app?

No. WebToNative is 100% no-code. Install the plugin, enter your URL, customise your app visually, and we publish it for you. For the advanced integrations, you will require minimal coding, which you can easily accomplish with the help of your documentation.

Does it support both Android and iOS?

Yes. Both Android and iOS apps are included. There is no separate plan or upsell for iOS. One subscription covers both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

Does my app update automatically when I update my WordPress site?

Yes. Your app stays permanently synced with your WordPress site. Any content change, product update, or new post appears instantly in the app — no rebuild or resubmission. If you change something at the app level, like the app icon, settings, or permissions, a new app build is required.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. WebToNative has deep WooCommerce integration. Products, categories, cart, checkout, and all major payment gateways (PayPal, Stripe, etc.) are supported out of the box.

How long does it take to get my app published?

Most apps are built and ready within 24 hours. Google Play Store review typically takes 24–48 hours. Apple App Store review takes 1–3 days. If you have an individual account purchased after November 2023, it typically takes around 25 days for your app to be published on the Google Play Store. For organizational accounts and personal accounts purchased before November 2023, it generally takes 5 to 7 working days for approval on the Google Play Store. For the Apple Store, the timeline is the same — 5 to 7 working days for both personal and organizational accounts.

Are there any hidden charges or limits?

No. WebToNative has a strict and transparent pricing policy. You will never be charged more than your agreed plan price. Builds are different for each plan, and there are unlimited builds for Pro and Premium plans.

Can I use this for a WooCommerce store?

Yes. WebToNative fully supports WooCommerce product browsing, cart, checkout, order tracking, and payment gateways. It is one of the most complete WooCommerce-to-app solutions available.

Can agencies use WebToNative for multiple clients?

Yes. Our Agency plan supports multiple apps and includes a white-label option so you can offer app conversion under your own brand. Contact support@webtonative.com for agency or enterprise pricing.

Does WebToNative work with page builders like Elementor and Divi?

Yes. WebToNative works with any WordPress theme or page builder, including Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Gutenberg, and more.

What platforms does the final app support?

Your app will be published as a native app to Google Play (Android) and the Apple App Store (iOS). It works on all Android phones and tablets, and all iPhones and iPads.

Is the plugin free?

The WordPress plugin is free to install. Building and publishing your app requires a WebToNative plan. A 14-day free trial is available at webtonative.com — no credit card required.
